commits.edited_message:
set alpha_dithering in VP8InitDithering

Check whether the alpha header uses ALPHA_PREPROCESSED_LEVELS directly in VP8InitDithering when initializing dec->alpha_dithering, instead of deferring the check to VP8DecompressAlphaRows.

Also only decode all alpha rows in one pass in VP8DecompressAlphaRows when dec->alpha_dithering > 0. For uncompressed alpha, decode a wider first strip so later macroblock rows reuse rows that are already decoded.

Change-Id: I723363f8ac482cd2419c585c68f6fb468a54926d

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>

use sliding window for decoded alpha rows

Allocate only a sliding output row window for dec->alpha_plane in
AllocateMemory (frame_dec.c) when alpha dithering is not active.
Size that window to the rows FinishRow() can have in flight instead of
the LZ77 copy headroom from VP8LGetWindowRows().

Change-Id: I2a32c3ed493f6e097e573cf5cf0de8a9c96fcfae

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>

coupling: VP8DecompressAlphaRows and WebPGetAlphaWindowRows disagree about how many alpha rows can be resident, and each edited commit only updates one side of that contract. 20e5a47, while the alpha plane is still allocated at full height (AllocateAlphaPlane, and after 666b5bb the full-frame region in AllocateMemory), decodes a 48-row first strip of uncompressed alpha so later macroblock rows reuse it. That strip is within the allocation that exists in that commit, and it is also within the minimum sliding window VP8LGetWindowRows() later installs (about 90 rows, or the image height when that is smaller), so the strip alone never writes past the buffer. 41f78ca then stops using VP8LGetWindowRows() for the alpha plane and keeps 32 rows: FinishRow() holds back at most 8 rows and emits at most 24 on the last macroblock, plus one macroblock of slack. Every request visible in that diff fits, and the 48-row strip is not part of the diff, so the cap alone does not overflow. Composed, the first uncompressed-alpha call (row 0, no dithering) raises num_rows to min(48, height) after the height check, while AllocateMemory and num_output_rows are 32. WebPShiftAlphaWindow cannot drop rows on that first call because min_needed_row is 0, and NoneUnfilter_C then copies the extra rows past dec->alpha_plane. Changing only the lines of either diff leaves the other side untouched: dropping the strip restores FinishRow's <=24-row requests, which fit in 32 rows, and restoring VP8LGetWindowRows() makes the 48-row strip fit again. Removing the overflow requires noticing that the strip added in 20e5a47 is wider than the in-flight cap added in 41f78ca.
